title: TrackSearch Load more follow-ups from RF-149's review
acceptance: A My likes first page that is empty but has a next cursor shows Load more songs, as the Music workspace's Songs footer does.

A Load more that fails with REAUTH_REQUIRED shows the provider's Reconnect, not only 'Couldn’t load more songs', and a cursor the API rejects (422) offers a way to start the list again instead of retrying the same cursor.
The screen-reader status doesn't read a partial count as the whole library while more pages remain.
Tests cover a late Load more page after a mode switch and after a class switch, as RF-149's resolution states.

resolution: Built in pre-approved batch #808 on branch fix/rf-242-tracksearch-load-more-follow-ups (product commit 938611e), in apps/web/src/components/TrackSearch.tsx and its test only. (1) My likes shows the Load more footer whenever a first page has a next cursor, including an empty one, as the Music workspace's Songs footer does; the empty line then reads "No liked tracks loaded so far from <Provider>." instead of "No liked tracks on <Provider>.", which stays for an empty last page. (2) A Load more failure is classified by the new classifyLoadMoreFailure: REAUTH_REQUIRED or NOT_CONNECTED (or a "Reconnect your …" sentence) sets the provider's expired state, so the status row reads "Reconnect <Provider> to browse your library" with Manage connections, and the footer shows the same Session expired notice as a failed first page instead of "Couldn’t load more songs"; Load more is hidden while the provider stays expired and comes back, on the same cursor, once a reconnect clears it. A 422 (the API's "Invalid likes cursor.") shows "Couldn’t load more songs from here. Start the list again to keep going." with a Start again button that reloads the first page; Load more is not offered for that cursor. Any other failure keeps the existing sentence and Load more retry. (3) The screen-reader status reads "<n> liked tracks loaded so far from <Provider>. More remain." (or "No liked tracks loaded so far … More remain.") while a next cursor exists, and the whole-library count only on the last page. (4) Tests cover a late Load more page after a mode switch and after a class switch, and a late reauth failure after either, which no longer flips the provider to expired. No API, contract, schema or provider-code change; CI uses mock providers and cannot show a real provider's expired token or rejected cursor. Startup entry 179.48 kB gzip of the 180 kB budget (179.04 kB on main 25a4b81). Polish notes, not in the acceptance: a 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED on Load more still offers Load more, which repeats the 429 now (the Music workspace does the same); the Music workspace's Songs list still says "No liked songs" above Load more for an empty first page (Dashboard.tsx, out of this ticket's files); in jsdom a classId or planBlockId change in My likes clears the rows without reloading them, which in the app only a plan-block change in an open picker can reach, because ClassWorkspace remounts per class.
